008package paint.shared.utils;
009
010import java.lang.reflect.Field;
011import java.time.Duration;
012
013/**
014 * Static utility class containing miscellaneous helper methods used across PAINT modules.
015 * <p>
016 * Provides methods for time formatting, numeric rounding, and
017 * robust boolean string parsing.
018 */
019public final class Miscellaneous {
020
021    /**
022     * Prevents instantiation of this static utility class.
023     */
024    private Miscellaneous() {
025        // Prevent instantiation
026    }
027
028    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
029    // MAIN (DEMONSTRATION)
030    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
031
032    /**
033     * Demonstration entry point for manual testing.
034     *
035     * @param args command-line arguments (unused)
036     */
037    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
038    // DURATION FORMATTING UTILITIES
039    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
040
041    /**
042     * Formats a duration given in seconds into a human-readable string such as
043     * "1 hour 2 minutes 5 seconds".
044     *
045     * @param totalSeconds duration in seconds
046     * @return formatted human-readable duration string
047     */
048    public static String formatDuration(int totalSeconds) {
049        int hours   = totalSeconds / 3600;
050        int minutes = (totalSeconds % 3600) / 60;
051        int secs    = totalSeconds % 60;
052
053        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
054        if (hours > 0) {
055            sb.append(hours).append(" hour").append(hours == 1 ? "" : "s").append(" ");
056        }
057        if (minutes > 0) {
058            sb.append(minutes).append(" minute").append(minutes == 1 ? "" : "s").append(" ");
059        }
060        if (secs > 0 || sb.length() == 0) {
061            sb.append(secs).append(" second").append(secs == 1 ? "" : "s");
062        }
063
064        return sb.toString().trim();
065    }
066
067    /**
068     * Converts a {@link Duration} object into a human-readable string.
069     *
070     * @param duration duration instance to format
071     * @return formatted string representation of the duration
072     */
073    public static String formatDuration(Duration duration) {
074        int totalSeconds = (int) duration.getSeconds();
075        return formatDuration(totalSeconds);
076    }
077
078    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
079    // ERROR HANDLING UTILITIES
080    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
081
082    /**
083     * Extracts a concise user-friendly message from a {@link Throwable}.
084     * If no colon is present in the exception message, returns the raw text.
085     *
086     * @param t exception or error object
087     * @return trimmed message string or an empty string if {@code t} is null
088     */
089    public static String friendlyMessage(Throwable t) {
090        if (t == null) {
091            return "";
092        }
093        String m     = t.toString();
094        int    colon = m.lastIndexOf(':');
095        return (colon != -1) ? m.substring(colon + 1).trim() : m;
096    }
097
098    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
099    // NUMERIC UTILITIES
100    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
101
102    /**
103     * Rounds a floating-point number to a specified number of decimal places.
104     *
105     * @param value    numeric value to round
106     * @param decimals number of decimal places
107     * @return rounded numeric value
108     */
109    public static double round(double value, int decimals) {
110        if (decimals < 0) {
111            return value;
112        } else {
113            double scale = Math.pow(10, decimals);
114            return Math.round(value * scale) / scale;
115        }
116    }
117
118    public static void initialiseDoublesToNaN(Object target) {
119        for (Field field : target.getClass().getDeclaredFields()) {
120            if (field.getType() == double.class) {
121                try {
122                    field.setAccessible(true);
123                    field.setDouble(target, Double.NaN);
124                } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
125                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
126                }
127            }
128        }
129    }
130}
